- (2026-09-14) Phase 3N.0 — agent recency. "23h 59m ago" on a brand-new agent was not a timezone bug: Claude Code 2.1.270 writes a ~131 KB attachment record after the conversation, so ParseSessionFile's 32 KB tail had no user/assistant entry and LastActivity kept its fabricated now-24h default (also: no model, Idle). Fix: tail window doubles to 2 MiB until a conversation entry is inside; last activity = newest timestamped user/assistant entry; zero = unknown → `lastActivity: ""` (UTC RFC 3339 otherwise), CalculateStatus idle; UI "Just now" under 10 s, details panel uses the shared formatter. Live: two spawned agents (transcripts 179 KB, conversation outside the old window) read Just now → 22s ago → 52s ago.
